newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: RTRS-Qantas sees 4 new planes this year.
newsitem.headline: RTRS-Qantas sees 4 new planes this year.

text.p: Qantas Airways Ltd, placing less emphasis on market share than cost management, said on Wednesday that it would take delivery of only four new planes in the current financial year.
"In the 1996/97 year, Qantas will be coming off two-year cumulative passenger growth of 20 percent," chairman Gary Pemberton told the annual general meeting.
"Current-year fleet expansion will be limited to four new aircraft deliveries -- three 767-300s and one 737-400," Pemberton said. These planes are produced by Boeing Co.
A Qantas spokesman later told Reuters that the company took delivery of three new planes in 1995/96 -- two B737-400s and one B767-300.
